Title: Public Preview: Azure Chaos Studio has User-Assigned Managed Identity and Custom Role Assignment

Body.Content:
Azure Chaos Studio experiments can now utilize user-assigned managed identities to manage permissions. Users can enable Chaos Studio to automatically assign necessary permissions to their identity selection by enabling custom role assignment. Read more on Permissions and security for Azure Chaos Studio Preview | Microsoft Learn. 

For more information about Azure Chaos Studio, see Azure Chaos Studio documentation.
